2. The objects of this Act shall be –

column3: to establish and facilitate gender equality principles
in making social, economic, political, cultural and
technological  policies;
to  ensure  that  every  person  enjoys,  without
discrimination based on sex or gender identity the
fundamental rights and freedoms guaranteed by the
Constitution;
to  facilitate  the  identification  and  elimination  of
systemic and structural causes of gender inequality
and gender-based discrimination, including direct
discrimination  and  indirect  discrimination,
multiple  and  intersectional  discrimination,  in
policy,  programmes  and  delivery  of  services  to
persons of different gender identities;

to 
take  measures 
to  redress  disadvantage,
marginalization,  sexism,  stigma,  categorising,
stereotyping,  prejudice  and  violence  and  to
accommodate men, women and persons of different
gender identities through structural change;
to  protect  human  dignity  irrespective  of  sex  or
gender  identity;
to  provide  equal  opportunities  and  an  enabling
environment to achieve results on gender equality;
